dispositions.rationale: The existing suite is the agy launcher's whole behavioural contract, one case per criterion of its own spec, including its stderr ledger in both modes. Passing it unchanged, with only the model argument rewritten, is the observation that nothing outside the model element changed. A path that suite does not exercise is a path the launcher's contract does not define, and no document obligation reaches it.

DEL-A1 states its obligation for any id in a vendor's naming scheme and checks an invented id and a version-bumped listed id per scheme. No finite fixture set covers every spelling, and the objection needs an implementation that matches the fixtures and not the scheme, which the pattern-per-scheme design DEL-D1 states does not produce.

DEL-A1 states its obligation for any Markdown file the lint reads and checks a file three directories down. A depth limit violates DEL-A1 as stated, and DEL-A2's reported file list exposes a lint that reads fixtures rather than the tree.

DEL-A2's obligation stands apart from the fixtures: the tree the slice lands on must itself conform, so the slice also corrects any existing file that names an unlisted id. DEL-A1 and DEL-A3 to DEL-A7 establish what the lint detects, and none establishes that the real tree is clean.

DEL-D2 and DEL-D4 state where a dispatching skill's effort and timeout values live. Which values the review panel pins per seat is owned by agents-config-9k9.408, and ac-attack's are its own; neither is a slice of this spec, so no criterion here can observe them.

No slice changes a worker instruction or the agy skill's stopping procedure, which already states the pid kill. DEL-C7 holds every file slice C touches unchanged outside the named passages, so the existing answers to those questions survive as they are.
A sentence repeated inside one file is a wording defect the slice's reviewer reads under DEL-C7, and no outcome a reader observes differs between one copy and two.

DEL-B4 states the obligation for every input and samples three, and requires the existing suite, which covers the launcher's argv and environment construction, to pass unchanged. The slice adds no branch that changes the child's environment for inputs outside the sample.

DEL-G2 states that every pairing is composed and spawned and that agy's refusal is what the launcher reports; a launcher that refuses any pairing before spawning fails that clause on that pairing. The source search is a second check, not the only one, and a loaded map is still a list the search and the slice's reviewer see.

The existing suite is the agy launcher's whole behavioural contract, one case per criterion of its own spec, including its stderr ledger in both modes. Passing it unchanged, with only the model argument rewritten, is the observation that nothing outside the model element changed. A path that suite does not exercise is a path the launcher's contract does not define, and no document obligation reaches it.

The existing suite is the agy launcher's whole behavioural contract, one case per criterion of its own spec, including its stderr ledger in both modes. Passing it unchanged, with only the model argument rewritten, is the observation that nothing outside the model element changed. A path that suite does not exercise is a path the launcher's contract does not define, and no document obligation reaches it.

DEL-C7 and DEL-V6 confine every slice's diff to named passages or renames, and the delivery and failover statements sit outside those passages. A contradiction introduced inside a named passage is a defect the passage's own scenarios and reviewer read.

Promotion before implementation is a tracker step the work facade enforces on the items section 7 lists. It is an instruction to whoever opens those items, and no acceptance check of the delivered change can observe it.

Landing order is stated in section 7 and is held by dependency edges between the work items. A check of the combined tree cannot observe the order two changes landed in, so no criterion of the change can carry it.
Reworking or closing pull request 772 is a tracker and review action on another item's change, outside the change this spec delivers, so no acceptance check of this change can observe it.
